extensionDescription.message: Monitor your inbox for open jobs in real time.

helpBannerText.message: Job Search Monitor scans your Gmail inbox for job postings from the senders listed in the "Tracked Senders" section, and filters them by the job titles you're interested in. A job is shown if its title contains any of the words in your tracked job titles. Matching is done without regard to letter case. For example, "software engineer" also matches "Senior Software Engineer".

addJobTitleDialogText.message: Add a job title to start seeing matching postings. You can add more titles later using the Job Titles section, located at the bottom of the page.

initialHelpText.message: Add at least one job title under 'Options' to start seeing jobs.

emptyResultsHelpPrefix.message: No jobs matched your tracked senders and titles in the last

emptyResultsHelpSuffix.message: days. Try widening the day range or adding more job titles.

jobsListHelpAriaLabel.message: Click for information about the Jobs list.

helpPopoverDaysText.message: how many days back (1–31) to search your inbox. The last selected value is remembered.

helpPopoverRefreshText.message: re-scans Gmail using your current job titles and day range. The first time, Google will ask you to sign in to grant access.

helpPopoverSortingText.message: click a column header to sort. Click again to reverse. Your column and sort direction are remembered.

helpPopoverOpenCopyText.message: "Open" opens the job posting in a new tab; "Copy link" copies the apply URL to your clipboard.

tipJarHelpAriaLabel.message: Click for information about the Tip jar button.

tipJarHelpText.message: You don't need to pay. Tipping will help us keep the lights on. Pay as much or as little as you like. Even $1 is appreciated.

refreshHelpText.message: Page refresh ocurrs every 30 minutes counted from the "Last refreshed" time or click of the Refresh button.
